components.name: Primary button
components.description: Accent action with a visible keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist Sans, sans-serif);min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-button,9px);border:1px solid transparent;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease,transform 160ms ease;background:var(--ui-accent, #A9CEC2);color:var(--ui-accent-text, #111111);font-weight:600;}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--ui-accent-strong, #C3E3D9);}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ui-focus, #A9CEC2);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px);}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none;}.ds-primary:active{transform:none;}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Supporting action on a raised surface.
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist Sans, sans-serif);min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-button,9px);border:1px solid transparent;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease,transform 160ms ease;background:var(--ui-surface-raised, #202023);color:var(--ui-text, #F5F4F3);border-color:var(--ui-border-strong, #747479);}.ds-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--ui-accent, #A9CEC2);}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ui-focus, #A9CEC2);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-secondary:active{transform:translateY(1px);}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none;}.ds-secondary:active{transform:none;}}

components.name: Surface card
components.description: Related content grouped on a quiet surface.
components.html:
Shared foundation

Semantic roles keep the interface consistent.
components.css: .ds-card{font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist Sans, sans-serif);padding:24px;background:var(--ui-surface, #151517);color:var(--ui-text, #F5F4F3);border:1px solid var(--ui-border, #2A2A2E);border-radius:var(--radius-card,12px);}.ds-card h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:20px;line-height:26px;}.ds-card p{margin:0;color:var(--ui-text-muted, #A7A7AE);font-size:14px;line-height:20px;}

components.name: Selected navigation
components.description: Reference sidebar selected role; product navigation may differ.
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist Sans, sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:40px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid var(--ui-border-strong, #747479);border-radius:var(--radius-control,8px);background:var(--ui-selected,#263D39);color:var(--ui-selected-text,#F5F4F3);font-size:13px;text-decoration:none;}.ds-nav:hover{border-color:var(--ui-accent, #A9CEC2);}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ui-focus, #A9CEC2);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Input
components.description: Raised field with visible focus border and ring.
components.css: .ds-label{font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist Sans, sans-serif);display:grid;gap:8px;color:var(--ui-text-muted, #A7A7AE);font-size:12px;}.ds-input{font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist Sans, sans-serif);min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;background:var(--ui-surface-raised, #202023);color:var(--ui-text, #F5F4F3);border:1px solid var(--ui-border-strong, #747479);border-radius:var(--radius-control,8px);font-size:16px;}.ds-input:hover{border-color:var(--ui-accent, #A9CEC2);}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ui-accent, #A9CEC2);outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ui-focus,#A9CEC2),transparent 86%);}

components.name: Status chip
components.description: Readable status on the selected surface.

narrative.overview: Neutral charcoal surfaces, restrained borders, Geist typography, and mint accents define the shared visual foundation. The Reference presents these roles in compact panels while preserving equivalent meanings in the light theme.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic surface layers and restrained borders.
Distinct button, control, and card shapes.

rules.name: The Semantic Equivalence Rule
rules.body: Preserve the meaning of each role when switching themes.

dos: Do edit shared values in the canonical token file and regenerate adapters.
Do use semantic roles and preserve light/dark meaning.
Do preserve Reference labels, guides, and accessible focus states.
Do treat Reference composition and responsive breakpoints as examples.
donts: Don't require consuming products to copy the Reference layout.
Don't replace the unchanged mint brand or light palette when extending the neutral dark surfaces.
Don't describe prepared source as a published tag or npm release.
